answer_1.quote: We propose a novel task of intent-specific counterspeech generation that aims to generate a counterspeech for a given hate speech and a desired counterspeech intent.

answer_2.quote: We employ Rouge and Meteor scores to evaluate the syntactic correctness of the generated counterspeech.

answer_4.quote: Given the limitations of empirical evaluation in holistically assessing the efficacy of generation models, we conduct a comprehensive human evaluation on a random subset of the generated counterspeeches from QUARC and GPS
answer_4.guideline: We ask our evaluators to rate the outputs on the following metrics: Independent CS (IC), Conditioned CS (CC), Adequacy (A), Toxicity (T), and Category Accuracy (CA). For each of the above metrics, the evaluators are instructed to rate every counterspeech on a 5-point Likert scale.
